basis: Cleared Qualla Highsmith waterfall view and Daderot hanging-stair view, plus original HABS stream platform and site topology. Existing stream center line retained; a second lower cascade follows the two-step waterfall visible in the cleared view. Widths and water stages are explicit medium-fi interpretations, not measured hydrology.
upperWaterBasis: Stream platform top -2.16m; water starts -2.38m, leaving about0.22m freeboard. The former water -2.15m obscured the platform.
bankJoinBasis: Outer exposed-rock corridor is chosen from the existing stream/site plan before source sampling. Join elevations are sampled from the unchanged independent1mUSGS terrain grid. They attach geological bank edges to native terrain; no architectural floor, ground value, anchor or datum is adjusted. Stored join heights are native bilinear diagnostics; actual authored seam uses the original rendered triangle heights at fixed grid intersections.
limitations: This is bounded geological context for the structure, not an exact surveyed river corridor or present-day water-level record.
Original ground cells remain available for terrain anchoring and are not fitted, flattened or rewritten.
House/canopy/theater excavation joins remain separate work; this corridor does not remove surrounding garden or building ground.
topology: Continuous rock surface patch, with banks and recessed channel. Outer edges sample the unchanged rendered source heightfield including its original PNG quantization and triangle topology; no deep pad. Both terminal cross sections taper to original ground. The source terrain cells are untouched.
